ModMetaData.name: IsoRim Waylith - Combat Extended Pack
ModMetaData.author: Lin
ModMetaData.description:
Combat Extended in IsoRim's 3D view and on IsoRimZ floors.
- Bullets, shells and grenades fly at Combat Extended's real height from the muzzle; mortar shells on their real arc - 3D models for CE's turrets, hand grenades, shells and ammo; retextured guns show their own art - Ammo cooking off flashes and throws sparks (can be turned off in the mod settings) - With IsoRimZ: shooting, explosions, suppression and shields work between floors
Not compatible with Combat Extended Performance Patch.
Combat Extended logo by the CE team, used under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
让 Combat Extended 在 IsoRim 的 3D 视角和 IsoRimZ 的楼层上正常工作。
- 子弹、炮弹和手雷按 Combat Extended 的真实高度从枪口飞出；迫击炮弹沿真实弹道飞行 - CE 炮塔、手雷、炮弹和弹药的 3D 模型；CE 重绘过的枪械显示它自己的贴图 - 弹药殉爆时会有闪光和火花（可在 mod 设置中关闭） - 配合 IsoRimZ：射击、爆炸、压制和护盾在楼层之间正常生效
与 Combat Extended Performance Patch 不兼容。
Combat Extended 图标来自 CE 团队，依据 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 使用。
